text_block_list.name: TV Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yikes, there's no way I can cover their 
training in weather like this...

A TV news crew stood thoroughly bewildered 
in the rain. They likely came to report on 
the academy, but hardly any students were 
out on the track.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, one more set...!

text_block_list.name: TV Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hey there! Mind if I interview you for a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes... *pant*, *pant*... If someone 
like me is alright with you.

text_block_list.name: TV Staff
text_block_list.text:
Why are you training in the rain? It looks 
like no one else is out here.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... That was my... *gasp*, I 
apologize for making you listen to me 
breathless. Let me catch my breath... 
*whew*...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's because I'm still not strong enough. 
To close the gap between us, I have to 
train twice as hard as everyone else, or 
I'll never catch up...!

text_block_list.name: TV Staff
text_block_list.text:
Such incredible passion...! What goal do 
you hope to achieve by going that far?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ――The title of "The Strongest."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To become the "strongest"— a name etched 
into legends for generations to come. 
That... is my goal...!

text_block_list.name: TV Crew
text_block_list.text:
"She was such an earnest girl, wasn't 
she?" "It reminded me of my own racing 
days, too." "I'm sure the viewers will 
want to root for her as well."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Perfection! That's bound to grab 
the viewers' hearts, no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"What a devoted, hard worker!" "I really 
want to see her shine in races!" 
"Royce-chan, we're all rooting for you!"

After the press left, one Umamusume 
rejoiced alone. If I recall correctly, her 
name was Royce and Royce.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ――Isn't peeping a bit rude?
choice_data_list: I-I was just passing by by chance!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You're <chrname>'s Trainer, right? Doing some 
scouting?
choice_data_list:
She seems totally different from her 
interview persona...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Just now, I played up the 
"hardworking Royce-chan" image that fans 
love to root for. Call it self-branding, 
if you will.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Records alone won't keep you in people's 
memories. The journey to becoming the 
'strongest' is what matters. Self-branding 
is indispensable.
choice_data_list:
You really know how to adapt your pitch to 
the situation.

You really know how to tailor your 
responses to the situation.

memories. The journey to becoming the 
'strongest' is what matters. Self-branding 
is indispensable.

You really know how to tailor your 
responses to the situation.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Adapting one's methods to the subject is 
only natural. Besides, we knew well in 
advance that the press would be visiting 
the academy today.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Making effective use of that sudden 
downpour was quite clever of me, if I do 
say so myself. Fufu, I can't wait to see 
the viewers' reactions.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That's right. That is my weapon.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's true that there are plenty of girls 
more talented than me. That's why I'll use 
my own strengths to catch up and overtake 
them all!
